Resolves #20277

Adds `Neo.util.String.escapeRegExp(value)` (`src/util/String.mjs`) and escapes search filter patterns in `Neo.tree.List#filter` (`src/tree/List.mjs`), `Neo.list.Base#createItemContent` (`src/list/Base.mjs`), and `Neo.list.Country#createItemContent` (`src/list/Country.mjs`) so regex metacharacters (`(`, `[`, `+`, `?`, `*`, `.`, etc.) match and highlight as literal case-insensitive substrings without throwing in the App worker (Contract Ledger: [`IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABi0-6Dg`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20277#issuecomment-6632225294)).

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline lint-staged + unit + e2e tests ran` (`--change-class capability`).

Evidence: L2 (`npm run test-unit` + `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/portal/DocsNavigationSearch.spec.mjs`) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-4).

| AC-1 | `src/util/String.mjs` (`regExpMetaPattern`, `escapeRegExp`) and `test/playwright/unit/util/String.spec.mjs` (`escapeRegExp escapes regex metacharacters and passes non-strings through`, red on `dev`, green at `83cc975571`) |
| AC-2 | `src/tree/List.mjs#filter` and `test/playwright/unit/tree/List.spec.mjs` (`filter treats regex metacharacters as literal case-insensitive substrings`, red on `dev`, green at `83cc975571`) |
